style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: golden satin ribbon is the main skin (phases 1 and 3), so golden satin keys with a rose-pink Enter; the clay cup and the rice sack are warm too.

images.why: Look: 'a strip drawn to scale, copied end to end or cut into equal pieces'; Stage: 'a length ... the strip along y 360', 'Copy lays the strip end to end'. A length is a ribbon.
images.prompt: A flat length of golden satin ribbon in a warm honey gold, with a soft satin sheen and smooth finished edges.

images.why: Phase 2: 'a total in grams ... the Regroup button ... stacks bundles of the larger unit', 'bundles of a thousand grams'; Textbook: '8 bags hold 10,200 g'. One bundle of a thousand grams is one bag of rice.
images.prompt: A small plain sack of rice made of natural jute in a warm tan, tied at the neck with twine, with a soft rounded belly and a gentle woven texture.

images.why: Phase 4: 'a capacity ... drawn as a column of water, with cups waiting', 'shares it among the cups', 'the cups fill level'. A cup that is shared into is a small clay cup (a kulhad), warm and seen open from above.
images.prompt: A small round clay cup, a kulhad, in warm terracotta with a smooth rounded rim, seen open from above with its hollow inside plainly visible.
